scope: one sensor_reading event; no queue-wide processing
runtime_fixes: Cast the UUID sensor identifier to text for the sensor_device lookup.
Pass the current reading value to compute_rate_of_change as required by its signature.
Serialize sensor_id as text in the sensor_alert event payload.

acknowledgement_recovery_simulation.method: After successful handler receipt, return only the same event to processing and invoke it with a new lease owner.
acknowledgement_recovery_simulation.interpretation: The durable success receipt skipped the handler on recovery; this was a controlled state simulation, not a process-kill test.

limitations: Synthetic fixture only; source tree was mounted read-only into the pinned operator image.
No network SMTP, Directus, or actuator call was made.
No TCP listener, real process crash, concurrent workers, or full event queue was exercised.
Three failed handler attempts remain recorded before the successful retry.
The fixture is not a clean baseline; its encrypted pre-handler checkpoint is retained separately and restore has not been rehearsed.
